crossRefs.note: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry…
Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of…
Now therefore see the king whom you have chosen, and whom you have asked for. Behold, Yahweh has set a king over you.
Behold, I intend to build a house for the name of Yahweh my God, as Yahweh spoke to David my father, saying, ‘Your son…
I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.
I will set up shepherds over them, who will feed them. They will no longer be afraid or dismayed, neither will any be…
“Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will raise to David a righteous Branch, and he will reign as king and…
“ ‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.
I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be…
“ ‘ “My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances…
Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
Take heed, therefore, to yourselves, and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd…
Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily, not for…
